changes: Prioritize a Latias pivot when the active blocks a ready attacker.
Allow Hyper Ball with exactly two discardable cards.
Avoid redundant Terapagos and premature stadium use.
Reserve and sequence Ho-Oh acceleration, Akamatsu, manual energy, and transfer.
Pick distinct Akamatsu energy names from the complete legal pool.
Delay a premature Boss that would consume the supporter needed for a larger knockout.
Avoid exposing a nonlethal Mega to a knockout while Talonflame can keep attacking.
Evaluate incoming damage as if the promoted candidate were active, not still on the bench.
limits: Regression cases reconstruct a single decision branch, not a whole human match.
